subject: general
question: Which of the following is not a 3-tier Panchayati Raj system?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tehsil Level Panchayat**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The 3-tier Panchayati Raj system in India consists of the following levels: **Village Level Panchayat, Block Level Panchayat, and District Level Panchayat**.
 
• The **Village Level Panchayat** is the grassroots level of the Panchayati Raj system.
 
• The **Block Level Panchayat**, also known as the Panchayat Samiti, functions at the intermediate level.
 
• The **District Level Panchayat**, also known as the Zila Parishad, operates at the district level.
 
• **Tehsil Level Panchayat** is not part of the 3-tier Panchayati Raj system.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Panchayati Raj system** was introduced in India to decentralize governance and empower local self-government.
 
• The system was recommended by the **Balwant Rai Mehta Committee** in 1957 and was implemented through the **73rd Constitutional Amendment Act** in 1992.
 
• The 73rd Amendment Act added Part IX to the Constitution titled "The Panchayats" and also added the Eleventh Schedule which contains 29 functional items for Panchayats.
 
• The objective of the Panchayati Raj system is to create a decentralized structure of governance where local bodies have the power and resources to plan and implement programs for economic development and social justice.
 
• Each level of the Panchayati Raj system is elected directly by the people, ensuring democratic participation at the grassroots level.
